findings.title: Certificate Has Expired
findings.description: Certificate expired 92.41 days ago. Browsers will block connections with SEC_ERROR_EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.
findings.recommendation: Renew and install an active certificate immediately.

findings.title: Incomplete Intermediate Certificate Chain
findings.description: One or more intermediate CA certificates were omitted by the TLS server. Clients without cached intermediates will fail validation.
findings.recommendation: Configure the TLS server to bundle all required intermediate certificates.

findings.title: Validity Duration Exceeds CA/Browser Forum Limit
findings.description: Subscriber certificate validity duration (713 days) exceeds the applicable CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements limit (maximum 398 days for certificates issued on or after the relevant policy date).
findings.recommendation: Reissue certificate with validity duration <= 398 days.

findings.title: Service Identity Not Evaluated
findings.description: No target hostname was supplied by the caller. Service identity authentication was skipped per RFC 9525.
findings.recommendation: Provide target_hostname context to authenticate certificate against the TLS endpoint domain.

findings.title: No Embedded Certificate Transparency Timestamps
findings.description: Certificate does not contain embedded SCTs (may be delivered via TLS extension or OCSP staple).

findings.title: Revocation Status Not Checked
findings.description: No live OCSP query or CRL check was performed for this certificate.
findings.recommendation: Enable OCSP / CRL validation to verify certificate has not been revoked.
